name: relavium-monorepo
description: Relavium — multi-surface, local-first AI agent workflow platform (HodeTech). Monorepo root (tooling only); the published CLI package is `relavium` (apps/cli).

scripts.ci:workspaces: turbo run lint typecheck && turbo run test --concurrency=1
scripts.ci: pnpm lint:test-isolation && pnpm ci:workspaces && pnpm db:sync-check && pnpm typecheck:tools && pnpm lint:tools && turbo run build format:check && pnpm lint:fence-check && pnpm lint:engine-deps && pnpm lint:bundle-closure && pnpm smoke:cli-package && pnpm smoke:cli-bootstrap && pnpm smoke:cli && pnpm smoke:media-packaging && pnpm smoke:overflow-capture && pnpm smoke:budget-replay && pnpm test:acceptance-tools && pnpm check:wire-mutations && pnpm check:usage-mutations && pnpm check:fs-mutations && pnpm check:secrets-mutations
scripts.sync:models: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@relavium/llm && node tools/sync-models-dev/sync.mjs
scripts.sync:models:check: pnpm turbo run build --filter=@relavium/llm && node tools/sync-models-dev/sync.mjs --check
scripts.test:acceptance-tools: node --test tools/ci/windows-headless-smoke.test.mjs tools/ci/workspace-scheduling.test.mjs tools/ci/require-native-db-diagnostics.test.mjs tools/usage-coverage-controls/outcome.test.mjs tools/usage-coverage-controls/workload.test.mjs tools/ci/require-w8-acceptance.test.mjs tools/acceptance-evidence/export.test.mjs tools/wire-conformance/provenance.test.mjs tools/causal-controls/outcome.test.mjs tools/causal-controls/process.test.mjs tools/causal-controls/provenance.test.mjs tools/causal-controls/retention.test.mjs tools/causal-controls/run.test.mjs tools/causal-controls/timeout-policy.test.mjs tools/bundle-closure/closure.test.mjs tools/cli-bootstrap/witness.test.mjs tools/ci/require-packed-cli.test.mjs tools/cli-package/archive.test.mjs tools/cli-package/binding.test.mjs tools/cli-package/process.test.mjs tools/cli-package/files.test.mjs tools/cli-package/smoke/process.test.mjs tools/cli-package/smoke/failure-diagnostic.test.mjs tools/cli-package/smoke/native-process.test.mjs tools/cli-package/smoke/runtime-stderr.test.mjs tools/cli-package/smoke/native-spawn-witness.test.mjs tools/cli-package/pipeline.test.mjs tools/cli-package/consumer-lifetime.test.mjs
